# a caller can pass any key; canon and the Tanakh are never reviewed.
#   kehillah_review_can_cherem_<work>_trigger    he may pronounce a cherem on it
#   kehillah_review_can_haskamah_<work>_trigger  ... and give it a haskamah (mastered)
#   kehillah_review_objects_<work>_trigger      it argues against what he holds

		kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_authored_23 = -1
		kehillah_sefer_work_heterodox_work_authored_23_trigger = yes
	}
}
kehillah_review_can_cherem_work_authored_24_trigger = {
	kehillah_review_reviewer_trigger = yes
	has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_written
	NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_reviewed_works target = flag:work_authored_24 } }
	NOT = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_author ?= this }
}
kehillah_review_can_haskamah_work_authored_24_trigger = {
	kehillah_review_can_cherem_work_authored_24_trigger = yes
	is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_24 }
	kehillah_review_haskamah_window_work_authored_24_trigger = yes
}
kehillah_review_haskamah_window_work_authored_24_trigger = {
	kehillah_lib_standing_work_authored_24 >= 4
	kehillah_lib_standing_work_authored_24 <= 7
	current_year <= { value = kehillah_lib_year_work_authored_24 add = kehillah_review_haskamah_years }
}
kehillah_review_objects_work_authored_24_trigger = {
	OR = {
		kehillah_lib_tenet_fit_work_authored_24 = -1
		kehillah_sefer_work_heterodox_work_authored_24_trigger = yes
	}
}
